name: Business Promotion
tagline: Helping businesses reach their audience and hit their marketing goals.
about: We are specialized in assisting businesses with their promotional efforts, helping them effectively reach their target audience and achieve their marketing goals.
mission: Help every member business get seen by the audience that matters most to them.
codeOfConduct: Share generously, no spamming other members with unsolicited pitches, credit collaborators.

faqs.question: Is this only for marketers?
faqs.answer: No — founders, business owners, and marketers are all welcome.

name: Foundation
tagline: Social welfare programs for disadvantaged communities.
about: We design and implement social welfare programs that directly benefit disadvantaged communities. These programs may include providing access to healthcare, education, clean water, etc.
mission: Widen access to healthcare, education, and opportunity for underserved communities.
codeOfConduct: Lead with dignity and respect for the communities we serve; report volunteering hours honestly.

faqs.question: How can I contribute if I cannot volunteer in person?
faqs.answer: You can support fundraising campaigns or remote skill-sharing initiatives.

name: Investors
tagline: Connecting capital allocators with investment opportunities and emerging ventures.
about: We understand that investors face the challenge of identifying the right ventures to allocate their capital, and our role is to offer insights and recommendations that align with their investment goals.
mission: Match capital with the ventures best positioned to use it well.
codeOfConduct: No unsolicited pitching outside designated deal-flow threads; respect confidentiality of shared materials.

faqs.question: What does membership include?
faqs.answer: Deal flow access, sector briefings, and the founder directory.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: Yes, within 7 days of purchase if unused.

pricingPlans.name: Annual Membership
pricingPlans.description: Full access to deal flow, briefings, and the founder directory.

name: Startup / Idea
tagline: Funding connections and business guidance for early-stage entrepreneurs.
about: We understand the challenges that entrepreneur of start-up faces in the early stages of their businesses and recognise the crucial role that funding plays in their growth and development.
mission: Turn early-stage ideas into fundable, scalable businesses.
codeOfConduct: Give constructive feedback, respect confidentiality of unreleased ideas.

faqs.question: Do I need a registered company to join?
faqs.answer: No, an idea-stage concept is enough to get started.

name: Mentor
tagline: Personalized guidance that fosters independence and resilience.
about: We understand that each person's path is unique, and we tailor our guidance to their specific needs and goals.
mission: Help every member build the judgement and resilience to navigate their own path.
codeOfConduct: Sessions are confidential; show up prepared and on time.

faqs.question: How are mentors matched?
faqs.answer: Based on your stated goals and the mentor pool’s areas of expertise.

pricingPlans.name: Monthly Membership
pricingPlans.description: Includes a monthly 1:1 mentor session and reflection circles.

name: Competitors / Organisation
tagline: A community for people who share the same trait or interest.
about: We aim to build a community of individuals sharing the same trait or interest. This can help in the development of powerful support system and a sense of belonging.
mission: Turn shared circumstance into shared strength.
codeOfConduct: Keep roundtable discussions confidential to the group unless everyone agrees to share externally.

faqs.question: What kinds of groups form here?
faqs.answer: Anything from industry peers to people navigating similar personal circumstances.

name: Chit Chat
about: Our chat system is dedicated to issue resolution. Experts could play a role in facilitating the conversation, ensuring that discussions remain respectful and focused on problem resolution.
mission: Give people a safe, well-facilitated space to talk through what they are facing.
codeOfConduct: Respectful dialogue only; no judgement of others’ experiences.

faqs.question: Is participation anonymous?
faqs.answer: You can use a display name; full anonymity isn’t supported.

name: Users
tagline: Support and guidance for your emotional, mental, or physical well-being journey.
about: Global Soul Healing, dedicated to healing services. Here user can seeking support and guidance in their journey towards emotional, mental, or physical well-being.
mission: Support every member’s journey toward holistic well-being.
codeOfConduct: Be kind and non-judgemental; this is a support space, not a debate space.

faqs.question: Do I need prior meditation experience?
